title: Sub-Sub: a research assistant for Zotero
description: A research assistant that works from your own Zotero library, on your computer, in your browser or in the terminal. It tags and imports items, writes literature notes and syntheses with a source for every claim, searches PubMed, Europe PMC and OpenAlex, and shows every library change as a preview before it applies it. The archive includes the published model-test results and blind judgements behind the site's Models page.
